paragraphs: R. Azaryah: R. Yehudah frequented him [R. Yudai stood before R. Azaryah bar Simai in the cited texts], Recanati and Midrash Ruth; R. Yehudah son of R. Simon. In R. Yehudah bar Ilai's name, Bereshit Rabbah, end of 42. In R. Yehudah son of R. Simon's name, Eikhah at 'He cut down in fierce anger'; He and R. Yonatan bar Ḥaggai reported in R. Yitzḥak’s name, Bereshit Rabbah 42. In R. Yitzḥak bar Maryon's name, in R. Ḥanina's name, Kohelet Rabbah, 'Man does not know his time'; Yelammedenu, Re’eh [Tanchuma parallel] and Tetze [Tanchuma parallel]. He, R. Neḥemyah, and R. Berekhya said, Shoḥer Tov 24. R. Azaryah and R. Yehudah son of R. Simon in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name, Bereshit Rabbah 15, 26. I do not know who this R. Azaryah was, since differing generations accompany him; perhaps there were two or three. R. Kohen in his name. For burial see R. Elazar ben Arakh.
